CustomField.description: Rule-based suggestion of what should happen next, based on Lead Status. Suggestion only - the salesperson decides.
CustomField.formula: CASE(Status, "New Lead", "Call the lead and record the outcome", "Contacted", "Confirm interest or schedule a call back", "Interested", "Schedule the discovery meeting", "Discovery Meeting Scheduled", "Hold the discovery meeting", "Discovery Completed", "Qualify the lead and convert to an Opportunity", "Qualified", "Work the Opportunity - prepare the proposal", "Not Interested", "No action - review in nurture", "Unqualified", "No action", "Review lead")
CustomField.label: Suggested Next Action
